intro: Iraq's culture draws on thousands of years of history, Arab and Kurdish traditions, and a love of poetry and music.

chapters.title: Poetry and music
text: Baghdad was a centre of Arabic poetry and storytelling; some tales of the Thousand and One Nights are set there. Iraqi maqam, a classical singing style, is on UNESCO's heritage list.
Al-Mutanabbi Street in Baghdad is famous for its booksellers.

chapters.title: Food and tea
text: Masgouf, a river carp grilled by an open fire, is a national dish. Dolma, kubba and flatbreads are common, and small glasses of sweet tea are drunk all day.
